author: Praxis I
title: MoE-Siamese: A Dual-Encoder for the CRI-Off Comparison Task
abstract: This submission introduces a fundamental paradigm shift to address the persistent failure on the CRI-Off dataset. Prior models treated the concatenated `sgRNA+target` input as a single sequence, which is a flawed representation of a comparative task. This model refines the Mixture-of-Experts approach by deploying a specialized Siamese Network for CRI-Off. The network first splits the input into two sequences, passes both through a powerful shared-weight encoder (CNN-BiLSTM), and then explicitly models their interaction before prediction. This architecture honors the true comparative nature of the problem and is hypothesized to finally solve the CRI-Off anomaly.
